description: Coppelstockstraat 29-49 (BAG 1933): 6.1 m red-brown brick pands of three storeys under a dark tiled roof with box dormers: three evenly spaced 1.3 m windows on each upper storey (two-over-two sashes, cream frames, sills), a wide 2.5 m ground window and the house door against the party wall under a small canopy; a light cornice band at 9.9 m

match.note: Coppelstockstraat 29-49 (BAG 1933, 11 pands of 6.1 m, 3DBAG eaves 9.8-10.0 m, ridge 12.7-12.8): three equal axes where Treslongstraat 5-59 (same year, same eaves) has an erker and a window; told by the photo (auto-place --photo-decides). 25/27 (13.2 m) and 51-55 (1924) are other fronts; Haringstraat 13-27 (BAG 1939, eaves 9.7 m) carries the same front, so the years run to 1940 and the face is pinned

gutter.note: Coppelstockstraat 29-49 strip: a light cornice band at 9.8-10.0 m, a dark tile slope with one box dormer per pand; dormers not drawn

door-left.note: the house door (1.1 m, 0-2.3 m) against the party wall under a small canopy at 2.5 m beside a wide ground window; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the right

roof.evidence: Treslongstraat 5-59 strip: dark tile plane from the 9.9 m cornice to 12.3 m, roof windows

rhythm.bays: three equal axes on the upper storeys
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored pairs: the doors pair across the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors under a canopy, two windows
rhythm.roofline: light cornice band under a dark tiled roof with dormers

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11-21 at 40 px/m read off the strip sheet (not gridded): three windows per upper storey, wide ground window 3.4-5.9 m from the pand edge, door 1.0-2.1 m, cornice 9.9 m, dark tile slope with a box dormer per pand
